change: Add stable current-user Store package identity and checked package executable resolution across updates, proxy environment inheritance for compatible CLI children, and selectable application/global capture modes with privileged global runtimes; Windows strict global startup remains blocked pending native guard and DNS qualification

archive_audit.source_comparison_normalization: CMD line endings only, normalized to CRLF as documented by the manifest

local_validation.import_validation_scope: Static packaged internal imports, in-memory compilation and isolated bootstrap entrypoint only; PyYAML and Windows runtime assets are installed later through the pinned bootstrap
local_validation.fresh_full_platform_validation: Required main and tag CI pending for this release candidate

windows.qualification_status: Not qualified; partial object readback or kernel experiments do not establish end-to-end Windows global isolation

linux.scope: Isolated real Linux kernel, production Lease and pinned Mihomo with synthetic local SOCKS targets; not a user-device or public Internet qualification

known_limitations: Windows strict global mode is disabled until both the independent WFP guard and NRPT DNS lease obtain complete native qualification; neither component is marked qualified in this candidate.
Windows application mode remains ProxiFyre path-based routing, not per-process-instance isolation. Other instances and similar substring-matching paths may also be affected.

Store application identity follows current-user registered desktop package entries and covers checked executables in the whole package. Ambiguous, missing, unsupported or excessive package contents are rejected; package-external helpers require explicit related paths.
No real ChatGPT Store installation, version upgrade, desktop GUI, OAuth login or external proxy-account login was exercised for this candidate.
Windows application mode does not guarantee DNS isolation: ProxiFyre passes UDP port 53 directly and system DNS service traffic cannot be reliably attributed to the originating application.
Windows application mode can restore direct connectivity after engine or driver failure. Its process monitor and Job lifecycle are not a persistent network denial boundary.
Public IPv6 connectivity and complete IPv6 leak prevention remain unqualified; upstream ProxiFyre permits IPv6 fragments to bypass its proxy path.
UDP compatibility depends on the chosen node and protocol. Controlled fixture forwarding does not prove real Internet egress identity or every application's UDP behavior.
Full Windows 11 interactive installation, UAC and reboot continuation, shared-profile browser GUI behavior, uninstall and reinstall remain outside this archive audit.
The online ZIP contains source and bootstrap scripts only. Successful archive verification does not prove that every external download or elevated installation will complete on the user's device.

Linux native qualification used disposable nested namespaces and synthetic local SOCKS targets. Interactive polkit, installed helper transport, user-device behavior and successful external DNS resolution were not exercised.

Linux global mode preserves replies for exact existing inbound peers; new outbound connections to the same peer address may be blocked, and new remote-management sessions are not guaranteed. Explicit stop is required to restore owned global protection state after a failure.
final_source_differences_from_linux_qual: Release documentation, workflow experiment opt-in and published JSON evidence only; runtime and Web bytes unchanged.
